body.cta_section_title: Want an integrated centre digital stack?
body.cta_section_text: Read the full BloomWave case study for project scope, results and how IGENTX coordinates website, AI and DaycareMate delivery.

content_blocks.content:
BloomWave Learning and Daycare is an early learning centre in Abu Dhabi. Leadership wanted parents to see a professional, trustworthy brand online, capture enquiries outside office hours and run admissions and daily care from one operations platform.

Fragmented tools would slow staff and confuse families. BloomWave chose IGENTX for an integrated delivery: marketing website, optional AI enquiry assistant and DaycareMate centre management software.

IGENXT launched bloomwave.ae on Next.js with Storyblok CMS so the centre can update content without developer dependency. The site presents programmes, trust signals and clear enquiry paths optimised for mobile parents researching childcare options.

A fast, credible website supports admissions before families ever call. See our digital tools guide for opening a nursery in Dubai for a similar launch checklist.

content_blocks.caption: bloomwave.ae gives parents a professional presence they can trust.

content_blocks.text: AI enquiry assistant with manual lead conversion

content_blocks.content:
BloomWave deployed an IGENTX AI enquiry assistant on the website to answer common parent questions 24/7. The assistant helps capture enquiry intent through conversation when staff are unavailable.

Qualified conversations are reviewed by centre admins and converted to pipeline leads manually. The assistant does not auto-create enrolments or CRM records without staff oversight. Embeddable enquiry forms on the site complement chat for structured lead capture.

DaycareMate handles admissions workflows, attendance, family messaging and billing in dedicated Admin, Teacher and Family portals. BloomWave uses the platform to keep daily operations aligned with the brand experience promised on the website.

For feature depth, read the DaycareMate product guide or the UAE buyer's guide for evaluation criteria.

content_blocks.text: IGENXT delivered a complete digital foundation for our centre: bloomwave.ae gives parents a professional presence they can trust, the AI enquiry assistant captures leads outside office hours, and DaycareMate keeps admissions and daily operations in one place. One team, one rollout, exactly what we needed.
content_blocks.author: Ajas Muhammed
content_blocks.author_role: Managing Director, BloomWave Learning and Daycare

content_blocks.content:
BloomWave shows that early learning centres benefit when website, enquiry capture and operations software share one delivery partner and timeline. Parents experience consistent communication; staff avoid duplicate data entry across disconnected systems.

body.faq_description: Questions about the BloomWave digital transformation case study.

faqs.question: How long did the BloomWave rollout take?
faqs.answer: The published case study notes a two-week project duration for the integrated website, AI assistant and DaycareMate configuration scope agreed with the centre.

faqs.question: Is the AI assistant included with every DaycareMate subscription?
faqs.answer: The AI enquiry assistant is optional and environment-gated for subscribers who want website chat. It complements embeddable enquiry forms; leads are converted manually by staff.

faqs.question: Can IGENTX deliver only the website without DaycareMate?
faqs.answer: Yes. We also deliver standalone websites and AI agents for centres using other operations tools. Integrated rollout is recommended when you want one team and timeline.

faqs.question: Does BloomWave use visit booking on their website?
faqs.answer: Enquiry and admission forms capture leads for staff follow-up. IGENTX embeddable forms are lead capture, not a hosted visit-booking page.
